entries.07a5b0e9f89fb3e8: A business that develops and provides standard components and other products used in factory automation machines (FA = factory automation). In addition to standard components such as shafts and linear guides, it also handles automatic positioning modules used in high-precision production equipment, optical technology-related experimental research equipment, and custom machine components. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥160,498 million, up 18.2% year on year, the largest growth of the three businesses. The company explains that capturing demand related to communications in China and its proprietary initiatives such as meviy, the Economy series and D-JIT were effective overseas. Fictiv Inc., acquired in June 2025, has been included in consolidation since July 2025 and is included in this business. The main operators are MISUMI Corporation, Suruga Seiki Production Platform Co., Ltd., Suruga Seiki Co., Ltd., Fictiv Inc., and others (37 companies in total).

entries.42451d9f63356794: The company says it contributes to automation-related industries, centered on the global manufacturing industry, by meeting customers’ needs for certainty and short lead times. No specific customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue. Regional revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥177,221 million in Japan, ¥91,947 million in China, ¥72,045 million in Asia, ¥63,307 million in the United States, ¥27,676 million in Europe and ¥9,184 million in other regions.

entries.49df9dfd11e92192: The FA Business provides standard parts for automated machines and custom machine parts, the Die Components Business provides standard parts built into dies and precision parts, and the VONA Business provides equipment parts and indirect materials, including products from manufacturers other than the MISUMI brand. The company describes itself as a unique business format combining manufacturing and distribution businesses.
entries.4bbcb091b80ee307: Die Components Business (¥88,368 million in the same period)
entries.4d0bcc889e16f6c2: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥40,457 million, up 10.7% year on year. The company explains that the main reason was the introduction of consolidated tax filing in the United States, which led to recognition of deferred tax assets for carryforward losses and a reduction in income tax adjustments.
entries.524e20562d9a8359: A distribution business that carries manufacturer products other than MISUMI-brand products, selling mainly through web sales. In addition to equipment components used in manufacturing and automation, it also handles indirect materials such as MRO (consumables). Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥192,516 million, the largest of the three businesses, up 7.1% year on year. The company explains that all regions were generally firm. The main operators are MISUMI Corporation, MISUMI (China) Precision Machinery Trading Co., Ltd., Suruga Seiki Production Platform Co., Ltd., and others (16 companies in total).
